title: Google Pixel 11 Pro 256GB $1749 with Bonus Nintendo Switch 2 & $174.90 Gift Card + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: Google Pixel 11 Pro 256GB $1749 with Bonus Nintendo Switch 2 & $174.90 Gift Card + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Harvey Norman

[Tommohalby] @4foxache: Good deal but felt like you gave away a lot of time with the security updates running out next year. Nearly have to update again

[OZBsince2018] Last week I got Pixel 10 from Amaysim for $499 plus $99 for 184 days 150GB plan and got $50 referral credit as well. So net cost of $548 including 184 days 150GB plan as well. That deal is still on I guess.
[atang] Convincing myself if this is a good deal..
With the $174.90 gift card, you can also get the Pixelsnap cover for the Pro ($79) and then do a price match on Ocarina of Time ($95) from BigW/Target etc. which uses the gift card balance almost perfectly (90c leftover)
So for $1749 you'd get
Pixel 11 Pro
Switch 2
Pro case cover
Ocarina of Time
Tempting..
[OZBsince2018] No difference at all between 10 and 11 series. So save yourself by buying 10 series from Amaysim or Telstra deals.
[OZBsince2018] And also only 512GB variants of 11 series Pro models have 16GB RAM, whereas all variants of 10 series Pro models have 16GB RAM

[493ryr] Got Pixel 11 Pro XL 256GB for $901.
Asked JB to match Harvey Norman deal for Pixel 11 Pro XL which includes phone + switch 2 Mario kart bundle + 10% value as gift card for $2099.
JB store person said they couldn't match switch 2 Mario cart bundle, however they matched 10% gift card value on top of their already existing $100 gift card promo. Finally got the phone + Nintendo switch 2 + $100 JB gift card, plus on top another 10% value JB gift card (208.90). Used $10 discount coupon that was sent in email 2 weeks back. Total cost was $2089
Had $100 Prezzee gift card from my workplace, also used Macquarie marketplace, which provides 4% discounted gift card to pay. In total, taking $100+208.90 JB gift card into account, the final price for this deal was $1,600. I would it take it as $699 for Switch 2 + $901 for pixel 11 pro XL 256GB.
[majoradeepstate] the processor in pixel 11 pro is extremely mid. you can find equivalents in $1,000 phones.
